messages:
alex.k: Hey security team — we have a partner auditor who needs temporary access to a private API endpoint in our prod VPC to validate dataflow. They’ll come from a static IP: 45.33.12.99 for a 3-hour window tomorrow. Quick Qs: 1) Can we allow that IP via an IP allowlist on the PrivateLink endpoint? 2) Any logging redaction we should do before they pull logs? 3) Who needs to approve the access? Ticket INF-4721.

maria.s: short answers: 1) yes, we can restrict the endpoint with an allowlist but we prefer limiting via an endpoint policy + SG rules. 2) logs: redact user identifiers and email addresses before sharing; we disallow raw PII. 3) approval: security-oncall + product owner. pinging @security-oncall now.

sam_t: ops notes: to allow the IP you'll need two changes: security group inbound rule for the bastion/proxy (tcp/22) and endpoint policy to restrict actions to the audit-role. Example SG rule:

```
Type: Custom TCP
Port: 22
Source: 45.33.12.99/32
Description: temporary auditor bastion
```

Also we should create a short-lived IAM role for the session and require MFA via bastion.

lisa_p: also add a VPC endpoint policy snippet — we should scope it to the specific resource and action. Example:

```
{
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/audit-temp-role"},
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-prod-logs","arn:aws:s3:::redwood-prod-logs/*"]
    }
  ]
}
```

security-oncall: @alex.k please confirm the scope of data they need. If they only need access to aggregated metrics + redacted logs we prefer handing over sanitized exports rather than live access. If live access is unavoidable, we need: ticket with justification (INF-4721 ok), PO approval, explicit retention policy for copies, and an ACL that strips PII fields. Also require an auditor NDA on file.

alex.k: They want to validate that ingestion timestamps and transformation steps match the contract — they asked for log lines for a specific 2-day window. They requested raw logs initially but we can provide redacted exports if that suffices. NDA is already in Zendesk: ND-889. I'll ask PO for explicit signoff.

maria.s: If you provide exports, make sure redaction rule removes these fields:
- user_email
- user_id
- session_token
Mask email patterns like `*@*` -> `[REDACTED_EMAIL]` and hash user_id with HMAC with team key. Document the redaction steps in the ticket.

sam_t: If we must enable temporary network access, we should do it like this:
1) Create audit-temp-role with only the actions in the endpoint policy. 2) Add SG rule for partner IP (45.33.12.99/32) on port 22 to bastion. 3) Add iptables or proxy filter to only allow connections to the audit target. 4) Log the session to the audit bucket (with redaction off by default, then run redaction job post-session). 5) Auto-revoke SG rule + role after 3 hours via a scheduled job.

devops-bot: Automated reminder: Create an Infrastructure Change (CHG) record and schedule a 1-hour maintenance window. CHG-2026 created for INF-4721. :white_check_mark:

lisa_p: small nit — prefer using AWS Systems Manager Session Manager instead of opening SSH; it avoids needing 22 open. We can still restrict source IP via condition keys and the session will be logged to CloudWatch + S3. Less surface area.

alex.k: good point. Can we do Session Manager + restrict by source IP? I can ask the auditor to connect over the proxy we provide.

maria.s: yes, you can block port 22 entirely. For SSM you can add a source IP condition on the assume-role policy and limit session duration. Example condition:

```
"Condition": {
  "IpAddress": {"aws:SourceIp": "45.33.12.99/32"},
  "DateLessThan": {"aws:EpochTime": 1767920000}
}
```

security-oncall: I'm fine to approve live access if all controls are in place (NDA, PO signoff, role scoping, SSM with ip condition, retention & redaction doc). Approving for max 3 hours tomorrow 14:00-17:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

alex.k: Thanks — PO approved (PO: @linda_prod via ticket comment). Plan: use SSM session with IP condition, role audit-temp-role, session logged to redwood-audit-logs, run redaction job immediately afterwards, revoke role + remove conditions after 17:00 UTC. I'll attach redaction script and callout in INF-4721.

maria.s: add one more step: run an integrity check on the redaction output (verify regex applied, sample 100 lines) and include checksum in the ticket.

alex.k: will do. tagging this resolved once the job completes. Closing notes will include the list of changed infra items and the auto-revoke timestamps. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
